newsitem.title: USA: AAR in engine venture with General Electric.
newsitem.headline: AAR in engine venture with General Electric.

text.p: AAR Corp, which supplies aerospace and aviation products and services, said Tuesday it formed an engine parts joint venture with General Electric Co.
The new company, Turbine Engine Asset Management LLC, will supply parts for certain engines, including CF6 engines made by General Electric, to aviation customers worldwide.
AAR said it will house the offices and inventory of Turbine Engine Asset Management LLC in its new facility in Wood Dale.
"Under this joint venture, we expect to contribute to reducing the cost of engine ownership, operation and maintenance for customers," David Storch, president, said in a statement.

"The combination of the strengths of our two companies -- AAR's proven spare parts sourcing and distribution along with GE Engines Service's years of experience in aircraft engine maintenance and reapir -- will further enhance the value that we provide for our customers," Bill Vareschi president of GE Engine Services, added.
